REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 26, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION
Staff Report
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
Staff Report
4.
ROLL CALL
5.
PRESENTATIONS
Staff Report
6.
PUBLIC COMMENTS AND SUGGESTIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
Items 7 and 8 under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7.
APPROVAL OF REGISTERS OF DEMANDS
7A.
City of Cerritos dated January 26, 2012. (COUNCIL)
for the City Council to approve the Register of Demands dated January 26, 2012, Checks 131141 through 131371, in the total amount of $2,971,699.74.
8.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
8A.
City Council Regular Meeting of January 12, 2012. (COUNCIL)
for the City Council to approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of January 12, 2012.
8B.
Redevelopment Agency Regular Meeting of January 12, 2012. (AGENCY)
approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of January 12, 2012.
END OF CONSENT CALENDAR
9.
PUBLIC WORKS ACTIVITIES
9A.
Consideration and authorization of the commitment of Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transit Authority STP-L exchange funds to complete residential rehabilitation improvements on various streets as part of the Residential Street Rehabilitation Program, Project No. 14088. (COUNCIL)
for the City Council to authorize the use of Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transit Authority STP-L exchange funds for residential street rehabilitation improvements, Project No. 14088, and authorize staff to proceed with the design and bidding of the project.
Staff Report
9B.
Report detailing receipt of Los Angeles County Regional Parks and Open Space District maintenance and servicing funds; and consideration and approval of appropriation of said funds for residential tree trimming. (COUNCIL)
for the City Council to appropriate the use of $500,000 to facilitate a citywide tree trimming and tree replacement project, and authorize staff to proceed with soliciting bids to complete the project.
Staff Report
9C.
Consideration and award of contract for the maintenance of control systems for heating and air conditioning equipment at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts, Cerritos Library and Cerritos Sheriff Station. (COUNCIL)
for the City Council to approve a contract with Johnson Control, Inc. for the maintenance of control systems for heating and air-conditioning equipment at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts, Cerritos Library and Cerritos Sheriff Station; and annual maintenance of the air-handling equipment and centrifugal chillers at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts, under the California Multiple Award Schedule (CMAS), Contract No. 3-07-63-0031B.
Staff Report
9D.
Consideration and award of contract for elevator maintenance services at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts, Cerritos Library, Cerritos Sheriff Station and the Cerritos Corporate Yard. (COUNCIL)
for the City Council to award a contract for elevator maintenance services at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts, Cerritos Library, Cerritos Sheriff Station and the Cerritos Corporate Yard to ThyssenKrupp Elevators utilizing TCPN Contract No. R5042.
Staff Report
10.
NEW AND OLD BUSINESS
10A.
Consideration and adoption of the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency’s amended Enforceable Obligation Payment Schedule (Amended EOPS) to conform with Health and Safety Code Sections 34167(h) and 34169(g), in compliance with Assembly Bill 1X 26. (AGENCY)
for the Agency to Adopt the resolution entitled, A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY ADOPTING AN AMENDED ENFORCEABLE OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE ("AMENDED EOPS"), IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF AB 1X 26; and authorize staff to implement all actions necessary to fulfill all notification and posting requirements as required by AB 1X 26.l
Staff Report
10B.
Request to authorize demand by the City to the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency for payment of the City loan to the Agency, and to authorize the acceptance as partial payment of the loan a credit representing the present fair market value of Agency ground lease payments for certain properties including in the Towne Center and Auto Mall. (COUNCIL)
for the City Council to order the following: Review and discuss the proposed payments presented herein; obtain public testimony; hereby demand that the Agency pay the maximum amount of principal on the City loan; the City Manager shall take all actions to collect payment of principal from the Agency; and authorize the acceptance of $1,000,000 from the Agency, and authorize the acceptance of the present fair market value of the Agency ground lease payments in the amount of $28,770,000 as a credit to the City loan.
Staff Report
10C.
BY COUNCIL DECISION - Item Added to Agenda - Consideration of A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, AS SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY UPON THE DISSOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY, AUTHORIZING THE INVESTMENT OF MONIES IN THE LOCAL AGENCY INVESTMENT FUND.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT OF THE NAME(S) OF FISCAL AGENT ACCOUNTS HELD AT UNION BANK.
Staff Report
11.
REPORT ON PENDING LEGISLATION
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
12.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings.
13.
ADJOURNMENT
In Memory of Mr. Ray Masigla, and Alfred Eclipse Jr. who both recently passed away.
